title: Stagehand
description: Companion for Stagehand, a browser extension and Android app that replace Foundry VTT's Setup screen with a module library, presets and per-world module management. It does nothing on its own: install the Stagehand extension or app too. It runs only for the full Gamemaster, keeps its exchange with Stagehand in the world's flags, and talks to nothing but your Foundry server.
